summary: A union at {workplace} files its proposals on time while it waits for management to schedule bargaining.
realLife: Fibreboard acknowledged the machinists' timely request to reopen their agreement. The union sent its changes, but did not get a meeting until four days before expiration.
gates: The case record identifies the renewal notice, proposed changes and bargaining calendar.
inGame: needs: renewal notice, proposed changes and bargaining calendar.

turns.what: Both sides have time to consider alternatives.
The union can document its attempts to get one.
turns.pulledBy: The deadline approaches without a meeting
